definitions.explanation: A very dark shade of brown, close to black. A traditional Japanese color name used to describe clothing, hair, furniture, and other objects.

examples.japanese: {黒茶|くろちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{革靴|かわぐつ}→革靴：15433_kawagutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought dark brown leather shoes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{黒茶色|くろちゃいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}り{替|か}えたら→塗り替える：06270_nurikaeru⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧になった。
examples.english: After repainting the walls dark brown, the room took on a calm atmosphere.
In autumn, the leaves on the mountain trees turn red, yellow, and dark brown.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧ (black) and ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (tea; brown). One of the traditional Japanese color names ({和色|わしょく}), describing a brown so dark it approaches black. The ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ component refers to the color brown (from tea), not to tea itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒茶色|くろちゃいろ}: dark brown color (with the ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ suffix)
- {黒茶|くろちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧: dark brown hair
- {黒茶|くろちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧: dark brown furniture

RELATED COLOR TERMS:
- ⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}→茶色：02915_chairo⟧: brown — the standard brown
- ⟦{焦|こ}げ{茶|ちゃ}→焦げ茶：18201_kogecha⟧: dark brown — similar; evokes the color of scorched things
- ⟦{栗色|くりいろ}→栗色：21884_kuriiro⟧: chestnut brown — warmer, reddish-brown
